pre_execution_questions.question: Which Windows primitive can enforce trusted-root/handle identity with concurrent replacement?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Inspect available native APIs and Python runtime first; implement bounded native-handle copy or document a demonstrated limitation; do not treat path.resolve as confinement.
pre_execution_questions.note: Native API/root/ACL and race evidence must be established during implementation; mandatory skipped tests do not close this question.
pre_execution_questions.resolution: CreateFileW no-follow, read-only sharing leases, handle identities/single-link/final-path checks and controlled snapshot lifetime; actual Windows NTFS fixtures passed within documented root/owner trust boundary.

pre_execution_questions.question: May the prototype touch real intake/Bank or claim all LW gates?
pre_execution_questions.answer: No. Synthetic temporary roots only, retain diagnostic evidence; no production Bank initialization/commits and no hardware power-loss test.

pre_execution_questions.question: Where do transport verification and domain acceptance separate?
pre_execution_questions.answer: Reader returns only controlled VERIFIED_TRANSPORT bytes with no Bank access; full domain/history/CAS/receipt checks belong to the next importer. See reader_boundary.

pre_execution_questions.question: What happens to incomplete, failed or cancelled staging?
pre_execution_questions.answer: Explicit outcome_matrix and staging_lifecycle; SI5 verifies no partial handoff, source retained, bounded diagnostics, resources closed and fresh retry.

acceptance_checks.check: Supported complete synthetic READY package yields VERIFIED_TRANSPORT only after secure bounded copy, strict envelope/binding/inventory and exact measured bytes/hash checks; returned snapshot has explicit protected ownership/lifetime. Later source replacement cannot alter copied bytes.

Traversal/ADS/reserved names/case collisions/reparse/hardlinks and marker/payload swaps cannot escape configured roots. Distinguish prevented attempts from detected/rejected actual mutation; neither may yield unsafe success. Check trusted roots/parents/staging assumptions; mandatory unavailable tests remain NOT_VERIFIED, never PASS.

Actual finite policy boundaries including READY/manifest/object JSON byte caps, file/package totals, files/operations and escaped-string-aware JSON depth are enforced before expensive parse/allocation with bounded chunks. Strict UTF-8 without BOM, duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity rejected; exact/above-limit examples, no truncation.

Record native Windows runtime/dependencies/handle-root assumptions and per-case expected/actual evidence; source/readback/baseline guards hold; changes only in allowed synthetic development paths; no real Bank, DB connection/writes, UI or R0/R1 release acceptance.

Missing published READY.json/only pending marker => INCOMPLETE; existing invalid/truncated READY.json or manifest, ID/hash mismatch, missing/tampered/extra payload and undeclared directories => rejection. Copy I/O/ENOSPC/cancel/owned child interruption never exposes a usable verified snapshot. Preserve input and diagnostics, close resources, isolate/reclaim own partial staging only; fresh retry/restart does not consume an orphan.

Transport/domain separation is observable: schema-shaped package with a pinned external-history reference may be transport-verified without a Bank DB; domain validity is explicitly not asserted. No full validate_package filesystem I/O/history lookup/CAS/ACCEPTED/REPLAY in reader; protected snapshot is sufficient for a separate mock consumer to read exact bytes without original-path reopen.

reader_boundary.scope: Transport-only bounded safe reader and controlled staging on synthetic roots; no canonical Bank connection or writes.
inputs: Trusted application/test-configured intake root and controlled staging root with documented parent/root/access assumptions
Incoming transaction folder; root/transaction identity checked before opening content
Exact LOCAL_INTAKE_LIMITS.json policy bytes/version and bounded I/O configuration
transport_checks: Published READY.json absent (including only READY.pending present) => INCOMPLETE with no snapshot; an existing invalid/truncated READY.json => REJECTED. Do not guess publication completion from mtime or treat parse errors as indefinitely pending.
Strict JSON and preparse byte/depth limits for READY, manifest and operation JSON documents; BOM, duplicate keys and nonfinite constants rejected
Envelope schema/protocol, transaction ID folder/marker/manifest agreement; marker size/hash binds exact manifest bytes
Unique safe relative file paths, reserved/colliding names, operation document_path bindings and exact file/directory inventory
Secure source handle/root/link/identity checks and mutation detection; byte counts/sizes/hash of every retained payload from bounded reads
Limits enforced on actual reads, not only descriptor claims; no truncation, fetch or executable/archive processing
delegated_to_next_importer: Full object type/schema allowlist and domain validation against BANK_TYPES/BANK_SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY
Object/envelope identity consistency, provenance and pinned-reference resolution against accepted history/current package
Type stability, base-head CAS, replay/transaction/revision-ID rules and whole-command atomic SQLite commit
Canonical ACCEPTED/REPLAY receipts, restart/recovery, original read/query/index/UI
reader_boundary.static_validator_use: check_bank_contracts.py is a fixture/pure-rule reference only. Do not call its validate_package/read_bytes/path.resolve I/O as the security boundary or require accepted history in this reader. Pure schema checks may be reused after bounded parsing but cannot imply domain acceptance.

handoff.meaning: Exact complete transport snapshot only; original bytes may still fail later domain/importer validation.
contents: Exact immutable READY and manifest bytes
Transaction ID and exact manifest SHA-256
Logical relative file inventory with measured byte lengths/SHA-256 and operation-document bindings
Controlled access to verified document/attachment bytes through protected handles/iterators or secured staging
handoff.authority: No ACCEPTED/REPLAY, commit IDs/sequences, new object/revision IDs or canonical receipt. No success token/usable snapshot until all transport checks and copied bytes are verified.
handoff.consumer_rule: Later importer reads only the verified controlled snapshot. It does not reopen mutable intake paths; snapshot protection/integrity lasts through consumption. Producer paths never select output destinations.
handoff.output_location: Reader/test generates isolated staging location under configured controlled root; never trusts a producer-provided destination or treats existence of a directory as readiness.

reader_boundary.resource_scope: Real Bank, live intake and unrelated processes are outside this task; only owned temporary test roots/child processes may be used.

outcome_matrix.condition: Published READY.json absent; only an unfinished READY.pending may exist
outcome_matrix.output: No usable snapshot; original intake untouched. Retry after publication; invalid/truncated existing READY.json is REJECTED, not a guessed pending publication.

outcome_matrix.condition: Complete READY invalid, truncated/invalid JSON, schema/protocol/ID/inventory/hash/limit/path/link failure or detected actual source mutation
outcome_matrix.output: Bounded diagnostic; no successful handoff or canonical receipt, input package retained.

outcome_matrix.condition: I/O read/write failure, staging ENOSPC or cancellation/owned child termination during copy
outcome_matrix.output: No verified output. Close resources; keep partial staging isolated/unusable; preserve bounded diagnostics and input package. Reopening a partial directory never implies success.

outcome_matrix.condition: Every required transport check completes and copied bytes verified
outcome_matrix.output: Controlled complete snapshot, no domain/Bank acceptance.

staging_lifecycle.creation: Unique reader-generated location/owned resources in controlled synthetic staging root, no overwrite of prior runs.
staging_lifecycle.failure: No success publication; close handles and isolate any partial copy. Return bounded diagnostic <= policy diagnostic_bytes. Preserve source intake and prior verified snapshots.
staging_lifecycle.cleanup: May reclaim only this attempt's disposable staging after diagnostics are retained and no consumer owns it; never delete/rewrite intake, other attempts or canonical history. If reclamation fails, quarantine/error is explicit and partial copy remains unusable.
staging_lifecycle.success: Retain controlled verified bytes while consumer owns snapshot; closing/reclaiming invalidates handoff explicitly. Verify protection/integrity until consumption.
staging_lifecycle.restart: Retry validates original package afresh using the same producer IDs/bytes; do not trust partial staging, allocate replacement transaction IDs, or emit a canonical replay receipt.
staging_lifecycle.fault_testing: Inject bounded failures/ENOSPC/cancel in own temp staging or terminate an owned fixture child. Do not fill the user disk, kill unrelated processes, reboot or power off the PC.

verification_reporting.mandatory_coverage: All SI1-SI6 cases must have explicit expected/observed outcomes. A skipped/unavailable mandatory confinement case prevents reader-ready/downstream secure-writer claims even if other synthetic tests pass.
verification_reporting.completion: Complete this task only when all mandatory scoped checks pass. If a required guarantee/test cannot be established, record the concrete limitation and blocked/partial outcome; do not silently narrow scope or mark SI2 PASS.
verification_reporting.native_uncertainty: U-1 remains pending implementation evidence. Choose and demonstrate native primitive/root/ACL assumptions; administrative/full-access attacker resistance is not promised by the existing contract.

Traversal/ADS/reserved paths/reparse/hardlinks/extra files and marker/payload swap reject; test unavailable privileged cases explicitly, never count skipped cases as PASS
Finite actual bytes/counts/JSON depth and strict UTF-8 duplicate-free JSON enforced before expensive parsing/allocation, boundary/oversize examples
Source/baseline guards and native Windows tests recorded; no writes outside synthetic roots and no release acceptance
